name: jarvis-mvp
description: macOS menu-bar mission control for Claude Code and Codex sessions: status panel, notifications, voice (Rust + Tauri)

scripts.start:power-helper-dev: JARVIS_DIR="$HOME/.jarvis-dev" JARVIS_DEV=1 cargo run --locked --manifest-path crates/jarvis-power-helper/Cargo.toml --features dev-uds --bin jarvis-power-helper-dev
scripts.start: npm run build:core-transport && npm run build:agent-vm-plugin && JARVIS_DEV_SIGN=1 cargo build --release --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --features wakeword-ort,whisper-native,stt-vad,power-helper-dev --bin jarvis && codesign --force --sign - --entitlements src-tauri/entitlements.plist src-tauri/target/release/jarvis && JARVIS_DIR="$HOME/.jarvis-dev" JARVIS_DEV=1 JARVIS_PLUGIN_DEV_DIR="$PWD/plugins" src-tauri/target/release/jarvis
scripts.start:prod: npm run build:core-transport && npm run build:agent-vm-plugin && JARVIS_DEV_SIGN=1 cargo build --release --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --features wakeword-ort,whisper-native,stt-vad --bin jarvis && codesign --force --sign - --entitlements src-tauri/entitlements.plist src-tauri/target/release/jarvis && src-tauri/target/release/jarvis
scripts.test: cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml && cargo test --manifest-path plugins/agent-vm/Cargo.toml
scripts.generate:plugin-contracts: cargo run --quiet --manifest-path crates/jarvis-plugin-protocol/Cargo.toml --bin export_ui_contracts && node scripts/generate-plugin-ui-contracts.mjs
scripts.bundle: npm run build:core-transport && tauri build --features wakeword-ort,whisper-native,stt-vad
